test.create_query: CREATE TABLE hits_wide_{size} AS hits_10m_single ENGINE = MergeTree() PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(EventDate) ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID)) SAMPLE BY intHash32(UserID) SETTINGS min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0

CREATE TABLE hits_compact_{size} AS hits_10m_single ENGINE = MergeTree() PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(EventDate) ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID)) SAMPLE BY intHash32(UserID) SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = '10M'
CREATE TABLE hits_buffer_{size} AS hits_10m_single ENGINE = Buffer(default, hits_wide_{size}, 1, 0, 0, 10000, 10000, 0, 0)
